how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format attached to the notice.
Attach Format-A, Format-B and all attested details and certificates.
Prepare the application in two copies.
Submit it before the Additional District Magistrate (F/R), Shravasti, or to the Revenue Assistant, Room No. 18, Revenue Record Room, Collectorate, by 23.11.2026, 5:00 PM.
Advocates of neighbouring districts may send their application through the District Magistrate of their own district within the period.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Magistrate Office, Shravasti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Magistrate Office, Shravasti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for District Government Advocate (Revenue).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Magistrate Office, Shravasti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format attached to the notice (pages 2 and 3, Format-A and Format-B)) and send it to Additional District Magistrate (F/R), Shravasti, or Revenue Assistant, Room No. 18, Revenue Record Room, Collectorate, Shravasti, by in person before the adm (f/r) or to the revenue assistant; advocates of neighbouring districts through their own district magistrate, to reach by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 60 years.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Advocates who have completed at least 10 years of experience in legal practice and hold the qualification related to the post.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must have completed at least 10 years of experience in legal practice. Application form asks for knowledge of Hindi / Urdu.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after 23.11.2026 will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A panel for the post is to be made available to the State Government.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is a professional engagement for a fixed period. State Government may end the engagement at any time without giving any reason.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shravasti district.
